column1: # Example: proteins co-purifying with the monothiol glutaredoxin Grx3 in Candida albicans, detected in all four immunoprecipitation-mass spectrometry conditions of the study (6 h and 16 h, with and without the iron chelator BPS).

# Source: Alkafeef SS, Lane S, Yu C, Zhou T, Solis NV, Filler SG, Huang L, Liu H (2020) Proteomic profiling of the monothiol glutaredoxin Grx3 reveals its global role in the regulation of iron dependent processes. PLoS Genet 16:e1008881. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1008881

# S1 Table (pgen.1008881.s001.xlsx): rows with Count = 4, that is, proteins the authors identified in all four Grx3 pull-down conditions; 65 proteins pass. Licensed CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); values as published.

# Columns: protein = UniProt accession as given in the Accession Number column; name = protein name as published (blank where the table gives none); orf = orf19 identifier as published; avg_LFQ = average LFQ intensity as published; conditions = the table's Count column. 53 of 65 listed proteins map to the species index; Grx3 itself is the first row of the source table and is kept as the bait.
